verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Adyen's Modification API supports refunding captured payments (via MCP tool wrapper and refusal-reason/modification docs) and a dedicated 'unreferenced refunds' credential role implying refund amount control, and the Customer Area is described generally as a place to manage transactions, but no citation explicitly documents dashboard refund issuance or the full-vs-partial refund amount parameter. missing for 10: explicit dashboard refund UI walkthrough, explicit partial-vs-full refund amount API documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of refund flow.
